html:
Victoria was a British colony in southeastern Australia, split off from New South Wales in 1851. The map shows it in 1880 and 1900, before it became a state of Australia in 1901.

Within weeks of its founding, gold was found at Ballarat and Bendigo. The Victorian gold rush drew hundreds of thousands of people from Britain, Europe, America and China, and the population grew several times over in a decade. In 1854 miners angry at licence fees fought soldiers at the Eureka Stockade in Ballarat. Two years later Victoria brought in the secret ballot, soon copied around the world as the "Australian ballot".

Gold money built "Marvellous Melbourne", one of the largest cities of the British Empire by the 1880s, until a land boom collapsed in the early 1890s. In 1880 the bushranger Ned Kelly was captured at Glenrowan and hanged in Melbourne. Victoria protected its factories with tariffs, unlike free trade New South Wales. When the colonies federated, Melbourne served as the national capital until 1927.

The colony was built on the land of the Kulin nations and others, such as the Gunaikurnai and the Gunditjmara, whose numbers fell sharply in the first decades.
sum: Victoria was a British colony in southeastern Australia, split off from New South Wales in 1851. The map shows it in 1880 and 1900, before it became a state of Australia in 1901.
